_description: HTTP 422 - business precondition failed. POST /api/v1/service-assignments/execute when no technician could be assigned: the MatchingResultResponse members are kept as extensions (requestId, assigned) and failureReason becomes detail. POST .../actions/complete uses the same envelope with the reason as detail; reusing an Idempotency-Key with another payload gives 'This Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request payload.'
title: Unprocessable Content
detail: No candidates available for the request in its service area.
